overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: staff review and the chair's individual extension did not amount to a quorum deliberation, and the chair-authority claim was outside the law and not reviewed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board deliberated outside a noticed meeting when the Park Central comprehensive permit filing deadline changed from June 30 to August 31.
allegations.key_passage: Review of the request for an extension of time to file the application by Board staff did not involve deliberation between or among a quorum of Board members, nor did the chair's individual decision to grant the extension until August 31.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board chair lacked authority to extend the filing deadline without consulting the other Board members.
allegations.key_passage: To the extent that the complaint alleges that the Board chair lacked authority to make this decision without consulting the other Board members, we note that, even if true, this allegation would not constitute a violation of G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25.
